Class BookRecommender

java.lang.Object
book.BookRecommender
public class BookRecommender extends Object
This class acts as the client-side entry point for the Book Recommender application. It handles the connection to the RMI server and provides static methods to interact with the remote Book Recommender service.
Version:
1.0.0 (30-06-2025)
Author:
Matteo Mantica and Leonardo Lambruschi

    • cercaLibro

      public static ArrayList<book.Book> cercaLibro(String criterio, String valore1, String valore2, String bookshelf, String user) throws RemoteException
      Searches for books based on specified criteria using the remote service.
      Parameters:
      criterio - The search criterion (e.g., "titolo", "autore", "autoreanno").
      valore1 - The primary search value (e.g., book title, author name).
      valore2 - The secondary search value (e.g., year, if searching by author and year).
      bookshelf - Optional: The name of the bookshelf to search within.
      user - Optional: The user ID associated with the bookshelf search.
      Returns:
      An ArrayList of Book objects matching the criteria.
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if a remote communication error occurs.

    • appendRating

      public static boolean appendRating(String userid, String bookshelf, String bookTitle, String bookAuthor, String bookYear, int style, int content, int pleasantness, int originality, int edition, int finalScore, String styleComment, String contentComment, String pleasantnessComment, String originalityComment, String editionComment) throws RemoteException
      Appends a new rating for a book by a user using the remote service.
      Parameters:
      userid - The ID of the user providing the rating.
      bookshelf - The name of the bookshelf where the book is located.
      bookTitle - The title of the book being rated.
      bookAuthor - The author of the book being rated.
      bookYear - The publication year of the book being rated.
      style - The style rating (1-5).
      content - The content rating (1-5).
      pleasantness - The pleasantness rating (1-5).
      originality - The originality rating (1-5).
      edition - The edition rating (1-5).
      finalScore - The final calculated score (1-5).
      styleComment - Optional comment for style.
      contentComment - Optional comment for content.
      pleasantnessComment - Optional comment for pleasantness.
      originalityComment - Optional comment for originality.
      editionComment - Optional comment for edition.
      Returns:
      true if the rating was successfully appended, false otherwise.
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if a remote communication error occurs.
